meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扫描整个项目，找出不再被引用的代码（函数、变量、类型、文件等），用LSP工具验证确实没用，然后分组并行删除，最后自动检查工程是否正常。
howto.when: 当你提到Remove dead code、dead code、cleanup、remove unused等关键词，或要求清理无用的代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我移除整个项目里没用的代码。
say.note: Claude会全量扫描并删除所有无引用代码。

say.text: 检查src/hooks/目录下有没有死代码。
say.note: Claude会限定在该目录内扫描并清理。
Claude只针对该文件/符号做验证和删除。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scans the entire project for unreferenced code (functions, variables, types, files), verifies with LSP that they are truly dead, batches deletions, and delegates removal to parallel agents, then checks typecheck, tests, and build.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', 'remove unused', or request to clean up unused code.

say_en.text: Remove all unused code from the whole project.
say_en.note: Claude performs a full scan and deletes all dead code.

say_en.text: Check for dead code in src/hooks/.
say_en.note: Claude limits scanning to that directory.

say_en.text: Delete the function unusedFunc in src/foo.ts.
say_en.note: Claude verifies and removes only that symbol.
